correctness.rationale: Two exact two-dimensional AdOGD trajectories satisfy the written initial nonzero-coordinate condition but annihilate an endpoint eigenspace at the seed step and thereafter have closed-form nonoptimal limiting stepsizes. A separate summable positive stepsize construction leaves both spectral modes at positive limiting amplitude and disproves the lower branch of Lemma 4. The supplied endpoint-persistence and cumulative-step repairs follow from uniform relative-mode contraction.

originality.rationale: The current arXiv v1, conference-program description, and targeted searches by paper title, AdOGD, theorem number, reciprocal-eigenvalue annihilation, secant curvature, correction, and erratum revealed no public correction or equivalent counterexample. A distinct final proceedings text was not located, so originality and correction status are explicitly limited to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The finding corrects the central optimal-stepsize convergence theorem of a recent adaptive-gradient paper, isolates an independent missing infinite-product condition in its varying-curvature lemma, and supplies a weaker repaired AdOGD hypothesis requiring only persistence of the two endpoint eigenspaces.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
